picks.annotation: great when enemies have over 2.5k HP + procs Heal tempo

picks.name: Battle Vest
picks.annotation: The OOC Regen and solid stats get us to 4.8k Vitality at a more comfortable pace. This is to be sold for a stronger Vital option later.

picks.name: Mercurial Magnum
picks.annotation: Can Skip & get Lucky Shot / Inhibitor / Unstop *IF* enemies aren’t stacking Metal Skin. With Metal Skin being common, this is a strong late-game pick, providing Spirit Damage to counter them.

picks.name: Rapid Recharge
picks.annotation: Smoke T3 is insane, with Rapid Recharge we are now spamming smokes for spellslinger and dispel / lifesteal is very strong.

picks.name: Cursed Relic
